title: Meter Bridge
summary: Compare Peak, RMS, Momentary, and Short-term metering against programme structure.
descriptionMarkdown: Compare four measurement time scales without unrelated analysis panels. A 60-second Waveform provides programme context above equal-width Peak, RMS, Momentary, and Short-term meters. Peak includes TP Max, while the loudness meters use floating values and remain profile-neutral. Stereo and 5.1 previews show how channel-aware Peak, RMS, and Waveform views adapt while programme-level loudness remains a single reading.
